_meta.name: amazon-pharmacy-export-prescriptions
_meta.description: Navigate Amazon Pharmacy, capture active prescriptions list, prescription history, and export medication data.
_meta.platform: Amazon Pharmacy — NOT a medical portal; pharmacy only
_meta.provider: Amazon Pharmacy (prescriptions from Haitham Serhan, Yafa Health)
_meta.authStrategy: Amazon account (mw@mike-wolf.com). Login is standard Amazon OAuth — interactive first run required.
exportFormats: Manual: prescription history printable from browser
anomalies: Amazon is a heavy SPA — navigate requires delay or perceive to confirm content loaded
Prescription list page may require scrolling for full history
No FHIR or CCDA export — data capture via perceive only
Auto-refill orders send email to mw@mike-wolf.com ~monthly; emails are the primary notification path

chain.note: Amazon Pharmacy landing. Will redirect to amazon.com/ap/signin if not authenticated.
Halt if redirected to amazon sign-in. Mike must authenticate manually. Amazon MFA may be required.
Amazon SPA — wait for React hydration.
Capture all prescriptions: name, dosage, supply, refill status, prescriber. Expected: Atomoxetine 25mg, Sertraline 100mg, Famotidine 40mg (all auto-refill).
Order history — shows past fills with dates and delivery confirmations.
Capture order history: medication, order date, delivery date, quantity. Useful for fill frequency tracking.
Insurance on file — captures which insurance is covering these prescriptions.

prescription-card.note: Amazon uses data-testid attributes in some components. Use perceive to discover actual selectors.
